## Research Interests

Quantitative methodology, population health, social policy, public sociology, sociology of health & medicine

## Teaching Interests

Introductory sociology, research methods, introductory & advanced statistical methods for social scientists, data wrangling and visualization, demography, structural inequality, health disparities

### Mentorship Experience

#### Mentorship of Post-Baccalaureate Researcher — Duke University

**2024–2026**

Taught and mentored a post-bac researcher in the lab of Dr. Hedwig E. Lee, imparting the fundamentals of advanced social science research and team science, including academic writing, editing and collaboration, and construction of advanced research questions.

#### Constellations Fellow — Duke University

**2025–2026**

Assisted in the development and implementation of an interdisciplinary liberal arts curriculum for first-year undergraduate students focused on inequalities and global histories; designed and administered formative assessments of experiential learning activities.

#### NextGenPop Graduate Student Mentor

**2024–2025**

Led a group of 21 students in the NextGenPop program; responsibilities included teaching key research skills, including formulating a research question, constructing a presentation, and developing a research project, as well as providing guidance for applying to graduate school and professionalization.

#### Undergraduate Tutor — Miami University

**2017–2019**

Provided 1-on-1 and group tutoring to undergraduate students in introductory and intermediate Spanish, introductory Physics, introductory Biology, introductory Chemistry, and Math courses up to Calculus II.
